args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Travel documents (passport/ID, flight tickets, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and accessories
- Medications and first aid kit
- Travel insurance information

Beach & Water Activities:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Sunglasses
- Beach hat or cap
- Flip-flops/sandals
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Hiking shoes/boots (for Diamond Head)
- Lightweight hiking clothes
- Water bottle/hydration pack
- Insect repellent
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)

Clothing:
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable fabrics)
- Light sweater or jacket for evenings
- Dressier outfit for the Luau
- Underwear and socks
- Sleepwear
- Laundry bag

Toiletries:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Makeup (if needed)
- Contact lenses/solution (if needed)

Electronics:
- Laptop/tablet (optional)
- Headphones
- Power bank
- Travel adapter (if needed)
- SD cards for camera

Miscellaneous:
- Books/magazines for downtime
- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks for day trips
- Small backpack/day bag
- Umbrella
- Travel pillow for flights

Activities-Specific Items:
- Pearl Harbor: Comfortable walking shoes, respectful attire
- North Shore Road Trip: Cooler for drinks/snacks
- Hotel Spa Day: Spa-appropriate attire
- Kayaking at Kailua Beach: Quick-dry clothing, waterproof bag
- Shopping at Ala Moana: Reusable shopping bags
